quarterly_data.quarter: ASUS press release: ASUS Ships ZenWiFi BN12, the World's First WiFi 8 Mesh (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: ASUS said its ZenWiFi BN12, which it calls the world's first WiFi 8 mesh router (unveiled at Computex), is now shipping: a tri-band system with speeds up to 19Gbps, WiFi 8 features such as Multi-Access Point Coordination, two 10G and three 2.5G Ethernet ports, and coverage of up to 7,000 square feet in the two-pack configuration.
quarterly_data.figure: up to 19Gbps; up to 7,000 square feet
